CustomField.description: Unique external identifier. Pattern: CSU_TAB-{number} matching the linked CSE-TAB-{number} on Case.External_ID__c. Used to upsert CaseUpdate records from Apex scripts.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Populate with a unique key from the source system (e.g. CaseHistory Id) to prevent duplicate records during data loads.
CustomField.label: External ID
